text: dsh-agents-md 为 DSH Web 提供自定义子 agent。插件读取本地 Markdown 文件中的名称、描述、可选模型路由和系统提示词，在聊天中提供 @ 菜单，并把 agent roster 放入系统提示词。主模型可用 call_agent 将任务交给指定子 agent，返回结果供对话继续处理；插件还会监视 agent 目录以刷新定义。适合希望按角色拆分任务的 DSH 用户，需配置可用的子 agent provider 和模型路由。

dsh-agents-md adds custom subagents to DSH Web. It loads prompts and optional model routes from local Markdown files, lists agents in the @ menu and system prompt, and lets the model delegate tasks with call_agent. Replies return to chat; directory changes refresh the roster.

dsh-agents-md 的功能「派发子 agent」：从 Markdown 读取角色提示词和可选模型路由；主模型通过 call_agent 提交任务，插件启动子 agent 并返回回复。
dsh-agents-md 的功能「@ agent 菜单」：Web 输入框按名称或描述筛选 agent，选择后插入 @名称 供消息引用。

@dingyi222666/dsh-agents-md README · How it works：Drop one file per agent into the agents directory (default `~/.dsh/agents/`). The file name becomes the mention name; the YAML frontmatter carries the `description` (shown in the `@` menu and to the model), an optional `provider`, and an optional `model`; the body is the agent's system prompt.

```md
---
description: Reviews code for bugs and edge cases
provider: google
model: gemini-3-flash-preview

@dingyi222666/dsh-agents-md README · How it works：`provider` and `model` are the names dsh's own model routing uses — the ones your Models page (or a `settings.yaml` `llm-*` section) configures. Omit both to inherit the parent agent's route. A missing or unknown route fails the child's first request, so use ids your configured providers actually advertise.

text: @dingyi222666/dsh-agents-md README · Configuration：The plugin row accepts the usual cordis config keys (set them in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` under the `dsh-agents-md` row's `config`, or with `!!js` expressions where needed):

@dingyi222666/dsh-agents-md README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agentsDir` | `~/.dsh/agents` | Directory holding one `*.md` agent definition per file |
| `provider` | `spawn` | Subagent provider name; must support the `persona` capability |
| `maxDepth` | `3` | Absolute delegation-depth cap for dispatched agents (`0` forbids dispatch) |
| `rosterPath` | `/dsh-agents-md/agents.json` | HTTP path of the browser roster endpoint |

@dingyi222666/dsh-agents-md README · What's missing：- **The model decides when to dispatch.** Nothing forces a `call_agent` call; a strong model may answer a `@name` request directly. Keep the roster descriptions precise so the model routes correctly.
- **Strict `{{…}}` persona rule.** The agent body is used as the child's persona, where `{{name}}` is a strict prompt-variable reference. A file whose body contains a complete `{{...}}` group is skipped at load with a logged reason — a lone `{{` without a later `}}` is fine. This matches dsh's own deployment-persona semantics.
- **Only `description`, `provider`, and `model` in frontmatter.** opencode's `temperature`, `mode`, and `tools` fields are not honored (dsh's subagent request has no temperature channel, and tool scoping is a separate capability).
- **Live reload.** The agents directory is watched: adding, editing, or removing an `*.md` file re-registers the `call_agent` tool's enum and refreshes the roster section automatically (debounced ~200 ms) — no restart needed. Editing the body or route of an existing agent updates the definitions the tool dispatches immediately.
